learningObjectives: Learning objective: draw a specified translation, rotation or reflection and describe the construction so someone else can reproduce the image.
Specify a translation: A displacement vector determines a slide.
Specify a half-turn: A 180° rotation reverses both coordinate signs when centered at the origin.

Criteria.Skill: 4.1 x=0 reflection reconstructs all three labelled vertices and their perpendicular distances after teacher-operated flash
4.2 two complete partner communication rounds with correct move parameters and four corresponding quadrilateral vertices
4.3 both ordered two-step triangle images with all corresponding vertices and why order changes the result
Original Edulytiks Cool-down exact final point triples, geometric congruence and order-sensitivity justification

correct: Reflection quick image x=0 gives (-1,1),(-3,1),(-2,3) with equal perpendicular distances
Partner reconstruction from exact (+2,0) translation of all four vertices
Two-step translate (+2,0) then reflect x=0 gives (-3,1),(-5,1),(-4,3)
Reverse order gives (1,1),(-1,1),(0,3) and is unequal
equivalent: Half-turn 180° clockwise and counterclockwise about same O are equivalent
Equivalent labelled drawings/oral or written complete partner directions
Each rigid step preserves all corresponding side lengths and angles
wrong: A single final numeric coordinate without two-stage reasoning
Claiming translate then reflect and reflect then translate commute for x=0 mirror and horizontal shift
Mistaking reflection for half-turn because side lengths unchanged
Inverting the displacement of only one vertex
malformed: Missing mirror line or point labels
Unspecified translation amount, rotation center or angle
Missing intermediate stage or partner reconstruction evidence
boundary: A half-turn 180° is identical under either clockwise or counterclockwise sense
For x=0 reflection point x=0 lies fixed and sign of other x coordinates changes
A teacher can accept complete spoken descriptions with equivalent labelled diagrams
Triangle order of transformations must be evaluated on original figure, not guessed by final shape
Coordinate-only optional candidate does not replace full human construction
